missions.title: Say what you think
missions.prompt: Give your opinion about an idea connected to the target word.

missions.title: Positive, negative, or both?
missions.prompt: Say whether the target word is mostly positive, negative, or both, and explain your view.

missions.title: Take a side
missions.prompt: Make a statement using the target word. A listener agrees or disagrees and gives a reason.

missions.title: Defend your idea
missions.prompt: Use the target word in an opinion, then answer one respectful challenge from a listener.

missions.title: This or that
missions.prompt: Give two choices related to the target word. Choose one.

missions.title: Best option
missions.prompt: Imagine your class must make a decision connected to the target word. Recommend one option.

missions.title: Convince us
missions.prompt: Persuade a listener to do, try, or support something while using the target word naturally.

missions.title: Short pitch
missions.prompt: Make a focused pitch that includes the target word and supporting reasons. Match the detail to the time shown on the turn timer.

missions.title: Find a difference
missions.prompt: Compare two people, places, things, or ideas using the target word.

missions.title: Then and now
missions.prompt: Compare the past and present using the target word.

missions.title: Make it clear
missions.prompt: Explain the target word through a situation without reading its definition.

missions.title: Why it matters
missions.prompt: Use the target word and explain why the idea matters to a person, a group, or society.

missions.title: Tell a true story
missions.prompt: Tell a short true story from your life using the target word.

missions.title: Connect it to you
missions.prompt: Describe how the target word connects to your daily life, school, family, or future.

missions.title: Solve it
missions.prompt: Describe a simple problem using the target word, then suggest a solution.

missions.title: Improve the plan
missions.prompt: Use the target word to identify a problem. Suggest possible solutions and choose one.

missions.title: Imagine this
missions.prompt: Create a realistic situation connected to the target word. Say what you would do.

missions.title: A real change
missions.prompt: Imagine a specific change at school, at home, or in your town that makes the target word relevant. Explain how you would respond.

missions.title: Ask and answer
missions.prompt: Ask a listener a question using the target word. Listen to the answer, then respond.

missions.title: Keep it going
missions.prompt: Answer using the target word, then ask the same listener one natural follow-up question.

missions.title: Show the meaning
missions.prompt: Give one realistic example sentence with the target word.

missions.title: Help someone
missions.prompt: Use the target word while giving useful advice to a classmate.

missions.title: Short story
missions.prompt: Tell a short story that uses the target word naturally.

stretch.prompt: If it fits naturally, include the bonus word too.

missions.title: Answer a listener
missions.prompt: A listener asks you a question connected to the target word. You answer using the target word.
